_note: C13 PLAN (milestone 10, not launch). Text only; ids proposed, Programmer may adjust. Bands: F1-2, F3-4, F5 (+ Guardian). Scaling: balance-research.md System 2 (ENEMY_SCALE per tier; floor 1 ~50% -> floor 5 ~85% of tier max PR, Guardian ~90%); wind-up ticks never scale (>=10).

dashOnlyTell.look: Purple-and-white diagonal stripes on the floor, shaped as a lane, an arc or a ring with a gap. Never a circle. A double '!!' over the enemy. A whoosh sound unlike the red circle's drum.
dashOnlyTell.counter: COUNTER does nothing; the button dims while the stripes show and DASH pulses (first 3 times).
dashOnlyTell.windupTicks: Never shorter than the blockable tell: at least 20 ticks (Brute's red circle is 16); tiers 1-3 use 26-30.
dashOnlyTell.stacking: Tiers 1-3: never at the same moment as a red circle (other wind-ups wait). Tier 4+: floors 1-2 never overlap; from floor 3 they may overlap with at least 10 ticks between them; never on Guided.
dashOnlyTell.firstTaught: White, floor 4 practice room (Sleepy Sentry), Health never below 1.

enemies.name: Swarmer
enemies.behaviour: Small, fast, comes in groups; jabs.
enemies.counterplay: Clear them first (C12 tip), or COUNTER.
enemies.scaling: Health and power by ENEMY_SCALE; group size grows by band, not speed.

enemies.name: Brute
enemies.behaviour: Big and slow; gets winded after chasing 4 s.
enemies.counterplay: COUNTER, or hit it while it's winded.
enemies.scaling: ENEMY_SCALE on health/power; winded timing never scaled.

enemies.name: Shield Guard
enemies.behaviour: Basic hits bounce off its shield.
enemies.counterplay: STRIKE or a Great Counter breaks the shield.
enemies.scaling: Shield regrow time fixed at 6 s.

enemies.name: Wick Wisp
enemies.behaviour: A tiny lost candle flame that drifts in a wavy line and bumps you.
enemies.tell: Flickers bright, then a small red circle.
enemies.counterplay: Punch it or COUNTER the bump.

enemies.name: Dust Bunny
enemies.behaviour: A fluffy dust ball that rolls straight at you, then sneezes.
enemies.tell: Wiggles in place, then a red circle at its front.
enemies.counterplay: Step aside or COUNTER.
enemies.scaling: Roll speed fixed; health/power by ENEMY_SCALE.

enemies.name: Lantern Moth
enemies.behaviour: Flutters at a distance and tosses soft glow pebbles.
enemies.tell: Red circle where the pebble lands.
enemies.counterplay: Step out of the circle, then close in.
enemies.scaling: Pebble count 1 → 2 at F5; never faster.

enemies.name: Sleepy Sentry
enemies.behaviour: A drowsy stone statue. It yawns and stomps a long purple stripe.
enemies.counterplay: DASH out of the stripe. It can't be COUNTERed.
enemies.scaling: Used only to teach; stays easy at every tier.

guardian.name: The Lamp Keeper
phases: Lantern sway: swings its lamp in a red circle
Wick wake: lamps light one by one
Dim stripe (dash-only, 30 ticks): one slow purple lane
guardian.freed: A spark... I had forgotten how warm it feels.
guardian.story: Once it kept the Tower's first lamp lit. The shadow made it forget, but it never stopped hoping.

enemies.name: Bouncy Bopper
enemies.behaviour: Bonks with a padded foam staff.
enemies.tell: Raises the staff and glows; red circle.
enemies.counterplay: COUNTER; a Great Counter disarms it (staff hidden).

enemies.name: Buzzy Bee
enemies.behaviour: Busy little bees in groups of 3-4 that zip in and out.
enemies.counterplay: Clear them first; DASH out if they crowd you.

enemies.name: Thorn Sprout
enemies.behaviour: A grumpy sprout that stays put and spits seeds.
enemies.tell: Puffs its cheeks; red circle where the seed lands.
enemies.counterplay: Walk around the seeds and calm it up close.

enemies.name: Shellback Snail
enemies.behaviour: Slow snail that hides in its shell when hit too often.
enemies.counterplay: Wait for it to peek out, or STRIKE the shell.
enemies.scaling: Hide time fixed; health by ENEMY_SCALE.

enemies.name: Vine Sweeper
enemies.behaviour: A tangle of vines that swings one long sweep.
enemies.counterplay: DASH out of the arc.
enemies.scaling: Arc width fixed; never paired with a red circle in tiers 1-3.

guardian.name: The Sun Gardener
guardian.freed: The thorns are gone. The storm wasn't my fault!
guardian.story: A tall, gentle gardener made of vines. The shadow wrapped it in thorns, but its roots still reach for the sun.

enemies.name: Spark Sprite
enemies.behaviour: Tiny warm sparks that dart around the ovens.
enemies.counterplay: Clear first; they're quick but weak.

enemies.name: Dough Blob
enemies.behaviour: A wobbly dough ball. When calmed it splits into two Doughlings.
enemies.counterplay: Calm the little Doughlings fast.

enemies.name: Ladle Lobber
enemies.behaviour: Flings soft soup splats from the back.
enemies.counterplay: Step out, then reach it behind the others.

enemies.name: Rolling Pin
enemies.behaviour: A giant rolling pin that rolls down a lane.
enemies.counterplay: DASH out of the lane.
enemies.scaling: Lane count 1 → 2 at F5 (never together early).

guardian.name: The Hearth Cook
phases: Hot pot rush: Spark Sprites join
guardian.freed: Is it supper time? I would love some company.
guardian.story: A big, round cook with a ladle. The shadow made it guard the cold ovens alone.

enemies.name: Pebble Pal
enemies.behaviour: Little pebbles that hop after you.
enemies.counterplay: Clear first.

enemies.name: Cliff Goat
enemies.behaviour: Lowers its horns and charges in a line.
enemies.tell: Stamps, then a long red circle at the line's end.
enemies.counterplay: COUNTER at the end, or step aside.

enemies.name: Stack Golem
enemies.behaviour: A tower of stones; each hit knocks one off and it shrinks.
enemies.counterplay: Keep hitting; it gets smaller and faster.

enemies.name: Boulder Roller
enemies.behaviour: Pushes a big round boulder down a stripe.
enemies.counterplay: DASH out of the lane.
enemies.scaling: From here, on floor 3+, a stripe may overlap a red circle, offset ≥ 10 ticks (never on Guided).

guardian.name: The Stone Giant
phases: Rock slide (dash-only): two lanes, one after the other
guardian.freed: I was stones and worry. Thank you for staying!
guardian.story: Very tall and very loud. Inside, it is only a pile of stones the shadow stacked up.

enemies.name: Puddle Frog
enemies.behaviour: Hops in an arc and lands with a splash.
enemies.tell: Red circle where it will land.
enemies.counterplay: Step out, then calm it while it blinks.

enemies.name: Mist Wisp
enemies.behaviour: Fades into mist, then reappears nearby.
enemies.tell: Always shimmers before it appears; red circle.
enemies.counterplay: Watch the shimmer, then COUNTER.

enemies.name: Side Crab
enemies.behaviour: Holds up its big claw and walks sideways.
enemies.counterplay: Hit it from the back or side.

enemies.name: Splash Wave
enemies.behaviour: A rolling wave across a lane of the river.
enemies.tell: Dash-only: purple striped wave lane + '!!', 24 ticks.
enemies.counterplay: DASH out.

guardian.name: The River Watcher
guardian.freed: The water is clear. I can see you now, friend.
guardian.story: A heron made of water. The shadow muddied its eyes, so it cannot see who is friend or foe.

enemies.name: Coal Cub
enemies.behaviour: Warm, playful little coal pups that pounce.
enemies.counterplay: Clear first.

enemies.name: Anvil Imp
enemies.behaviour: A small strong worker who taps a big hammer.
enemies.counterplay: COUNTER the tap.

enemies.name: Bellows Puff
enemies.behaviour: Huffs gusts that nudge you across the room.
enemies.tell: Inflates; a pale gust arrow (no damage).
enemies.counterplay: Stand side-on, or use the push to escape.
enemies.scaling: Push strength fixed; never into a hazard.

enemies.name: Forge Sweeper
enemies.behaviour: A big glowing broom that sweeps a wide arc.
enemies.counterplay: DASH out of the arc.

guardian.name: The Ember Knight
guardian.freed: I was guarding the wrong thing. Shields are for helping.
guardian.story: A knight of glowing metal. The shadow told it to protect the forge from everyone.

enemies.name: Masklet
enemies.behaviour: Little floating masks that giggle and gather.
enemies.counterplay: Clear first.

enemies.name: Copycat Shade
enemies.behaviour: Copies your last move a moment later.
enemies.tell: Your move's shape in red, then it hits.
enemies.counterplay: Do something different; COUNTER its copy.
enemies.scaling: Copy delay fixed. Appears from floor 3 only.

enemies.name: Hush Guard
enemies.behaviour: Silent shield-bearer who turns to face you.
enemies.counterplay: Circle round, or STRIKE.

enemies.name: Echo Bell
enemies.behaviour: A bell that rings a purple striped ring outward with one gap.
enemies.tell: Dash-only: striped ring + '!!', 22 ticks; gap glows.
enemies.counterplay: DASH through the gap or out of the room edge.

guardian.name: The Echo Mask
phases: Echo ring (dash-only): striped ring with a gap
guardian.freed: I copied what I heard. Now I hear kindness.
guardian.story: A floating mask that copies your moves. Under the mask, it is lonely.

enemies.name: Page Flutter
enemies.behaviour: Loose pages that flap like birds.
enemies.counterplay: Clear first.

enemies.name: Bookworm
enemies.behaviour: Tunnels under the floor and pops up.
enemies.tell: A dirt bump moves toward you; red circle.
enemies.counterplay: Step off the bump; calm it when it pops up.

enemies.name: Ink Blot
enemies.behaviour: Leaves sticky ink puddles that slow you about 30% (15% on Guided; no damage; ends when you step out).
enemies.tell: Puddle drawn as a dark blue blot.
enemies.counterplay: Keep space; fight on clean floor.

enemies.name: Root Snapper
enemies.behaviour: Roots poke up along a line, one after another.
enemies.counterplay: DASH out.

guardian.name: The Root Keeper
guardian.freed: Take a book, little one. Your story belongs here too.
guardian.story: A wise old tree who reads every book. The shadow made it forget how to share them.

enemies.name: Cloud Puff
enemies.behaviour: Fluffy clouds; a big one splits into two small ones.
enemies.counterplay: Clear small ones first.

enemies.name: Gust Sprite
enemies.behaviour: Spins and blows you sideways.
enemies.counterplay: Brace side-on or use it to escape.

enemies.name: Thunder Drum
enemies.behaviour: Beats a steady rhythm: boom, boom, BOOM.
enemies.tell: Three red circles in a beat.
enemies.counterplay: Learn the beat; COUNTER the big one.

enemies.name: Zap Kite
enemies.behaviour: A kite that drags a zig-zag lightning stripe.
enemies.counterplay: DASH across or out.

guardian.name: The Storm Herald
guardian.freed: The wind is still. Listen. Someone is calling from the top.
guardian.story: A tall figure of wind and lightning. It shouts the storm louder so no one hears the calm.

enemies.name: Storm Wisp
enemies.behaviour: Quick storm-cloud wisps.
enemies.counterplay: Clear first.
enemies.scaling: Top of ENEMY_SCALE. Endless: +3% per floor, no cap (Jay's call).

enemies.name: Rumble Brute
enemies.behaviour: A big storm-wrapped brute; gets winded like a Brute.
enemies.counterplay: COUNTER, or hit while winded.

enemies.name: Echo Knight
enemies.behaviour: Remembers every guard trick: shield, turn and copy.
enemies.counterplay: STRIKE, circle round, change your move.
enemies.scaling: Mixes three tells; each stays readable.

enemies.name: Sky Sweeper
enemies.behaviour: A gust that sweeps an arc, then a lane.
enemies.tell: Dash-only: arc then lane, each + '!!', 20 ticks.
enemies.counterplay: DASH twice.
enemies.scaling: Two in a row, at least 20 ticks apart, never at the same time.

guardian.name: The Lost Lightbearer
phases: Shadow echoes of earlier Guardians, one move each
guardian.freed: You came all this way to help? Now we can finish together.
guardian.story: The traveler, wrapped in storm clouds. They are tired from holding the last piece.

guardians.idea: A tree planted by the water
